results.rationale: Consistency: small bag, cords, beads and white setting largely remain, with slight small-bag fabric/fold variation. Instruction: the right bag remains much taller and wider than the left, so the size match is absent. Quality: the large bag appears suspended above a separate soft shadow, a clear grounding problem; fabric and cords otherwise remain coherent.

Consistency: monitor casing, cuff folds/shape, branding and background are noticeably altered. Instruction: blood pressure changes from 100/68 to a clear 188/88, satisfying the requested elevated values. Knowledge: both readings exceed the supplied systolic/diastolic thresholds. Quality: several device labels and the brand/model are garbled, with distorted small symbols and cuff-label detail, despite recognizable product structure.
